<MethodEndpoint
  method={"delete"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users/{userId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Permanently deletes credentials and releases their login name for reuse.

This can't be undone. Files aren't deleted: they stay in your storage, reachable through other
credentials with access to them. You can't delete the organization's default credentials. To
stop access but keep the credentials, deactivate them instead.
